fresh_read_only_critic.coverage: Ordinary Terrain/cell-overlay gate, native evidence and tree/low wood bridge integration; rock identification unresolved during pass.

limitations: Prepared native fixtures supply visibility state; no native reveal producer or complete Scenario execution. Terrain draw sink stops before raster; bridge raster uses supplied A/Z surfaces and prepared temperate resources, not a composited native shroud frame.

Rust captures use real SNOW XShrapnel.MAP and one normal tank route per object family on DX12, with shroud enabled and FogOfWar disabled. No exhaustive native pixel, animated/death lifecycle, enabled FogOfWar/gap or all-overlay parity claim.
Frame wall means include startup shader costs, simulation, observation, rendering and pacing; they are not GPU duration or ordinary gameplay FPS.

Additional owner captures establish the real SROCK05 overlay first-reveal repair on this route. The exact shoreline cluster in the user video remains unidentified; TMP details and every stone category are not certified.
